description: The allocate-check: the one call an allocating agent makes before money moves (VTR-1 Agent Profile §06, A-26..A-31). Resolves the counterparty (credential id, alias, wallet, ERC-8004 id, card URL or receipt), verifies credential, live status, receipt signature, bundle hash + Bitcoin anchor, log inclusion, provenance class (FORWARD vs BACKTEST) and record age. Returns ALLOW or REFUSE with every check and clause, the machine-readable verdict object (A-35) and a signed 24 h token to keep as the reason you allocated. Fail closed. With api_key and record=true, the check is logged as a public leaf (proof that you checked).
name: allocate_check
